test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the budget allocation for the Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Yojana (PM Vishwakarma Scheme) for the period from 2023-24 to 2027-28?
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹13,000 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Vishwakarma Yojana (PM Vishwakarma Scheme) is allocated a budget of **₹13,000 crore** for the period from 2023-24 to 2027-28.
 
• This scheme aims to provide financial support to traditional artisans and craftsmen in India.
 
• PM Vishwakarma Scheme focuses on the upliftment and enhancement of skills of the Vishwakarma community, who are engaged in traditional crafts.
 
• The initiative is in line with the government's vision of empowering the artisan community and preserving traditional craftsmanship.
 
• The scheme will include various components such as skill training, financial assistance, and market linkages to ensure holistic development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vishwakarma Community:**

 
 
• The Vishwakarma community comprises traditional artisans such as carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, sculptors, and masons.
 
• They have a significant role in preserving India's cultural heritage through their craftsmanship.
 
 
 
• **Skill Development:**
 
 
• The scheme includes skill development programs to enhance the existing skills of artisans.
 
• Training will be provided to improve the quality and productivity of their crafts.
 
 
 
• **Financial Assistance:**
 
 
• Financial support will be provided to artisans for procuring raw materials and modern tools.
 
• This will help them to scale their operations and improve their income.
 
 
 
• **Market Linkages:**
 
 
• The scheme aims to create market linkages for traditional crafts to ensure better market access.
 
• It will help artisans to reach a wider customer base and increase their sales.
 
 
 
• **Preservation of Heritage:**
 
 
• The scheme is a step towards preserving India's rich cultural heritage and traditional crafts.
 
• It aims to encourage the younger generation to take up traditional crafts as a viable career option.
